description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodFactory class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It provides methods to create instances of timesheet period classes, currently including a method to instantiate WeeklyTimesheetPeriod objects.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of timesheet period classes, such as WeeklyTimesheetPeriod.

methods.name: createTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of a timesheet period class specified by the class name parameter.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Creates and returns a new WeeklyTimesheetPeriod instance.
